## What this card carries

A 9-line addition to `AGENTS.md`, written by the implementer of card objectui#9660 and **removed from PR objectui#9730 on this seat's instruction** before it could land. The code half of that card — `scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs` plus its test — stays in objectui#9730 and is ⛔ **not** part of this card.

## Why it was removed rather than landed

`AGENTS.md` is in `GOVERNED_SURFACES` — measured, ⛔ not assumed, at `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs:872`:

```
Object.freeze({ id: 'agents-md', exact: 'AGENTS.md', glob: 'AGENTS.md', what: 'the repo-root agent instruction file' }),
```

⇒ it sits beside `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**` and `skills/**`. A governed-surface PR needs an APPROVED review from `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` before it may go ready, enter the queue or carry auto-merge, and ⛔ the `domain:spec` seat may never supply that approval under any account. Card objectui#9660 is `domain:spec`; the guard is squarely that lane's, the instruction file is not.

⚠️ **How much this file is load-bearing, measured rather than asserted.** objectui#9730's `changeset-claim-re-read` reported **four pending changesets** citing `AGENTS.md` as the authority for a contract — `6357-basechema-bind-declaration.md` (§4, the node shape), `6505-predicate-valued-gate-rules.md` (§4, predicates as expressions), and `7122-spec-17-3-0-parity-reconciliation.md` and `7714-lookup-draft-stays-client-side.md` (both for the rule that objectui's own breaking changes ship `minor` because its major tracks `@objectstack`'s). ⭐ Four published release notes measure themselves against this file. That is what 「governed」 buys, and it is why the removal was right even though the content is good.

⛔ None of the four is falsified by the removed text — it is an **addition**, in a different section. Checked, not skipped.

## The removed text, verbatim

It belongs after the existing 「路径过滤零匹配也不再是绿的」 bullet in the vitest-invocation section:

> - **`-t` 是正则,不是字面量(objectui#9660)。** 本仓的 `describe` 名普遍以 `(objectui#NNNN)`
>   结尾,整段复制粘贴进 `-t`,那对括号就成了捕获组 —— 一个测试都匹配不到,而「名字过滤零匹配」
>   在 vitest 里算 **skipped、不算失败**:`Tests 22 skipped (22)` + **退出码 0**。文件过滤是匹配上
>   了的,所以上一条的 `passWithNoTests` 在这里什么都管不到,屏幕上也没有任何 `0 tests matched`。
>   于是「跑一下那条具名 pin 看过没过」得到的是一个**假绿**。正确写法两种:把元字符转义
>   (`-t 'not prose \(objectui#7733\)'`),或者只取名字里一段**不含元字符的子串**
>   (`-t 'are derived, not prose'`)。⛔ 别按退出码读结论 —— 读「passed 的计数不是 0」。
>   这一形态现已由 `scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs` 直接拒绝;⛔ 它今天拒绝哪些形态同样不写在这里,
>   以 `scripts/__tests__/vitest-invocation-guard.test.ts` 为准。

## ⭐ Land it in this shape, and ⛔ do not "improve" it

The last clause is the part a taker will be tempted to expand, and expanding it is the defect:

> ⛔ 它今天拒绝哪些形态同样不写在这里,以 `scripts/__tests__/vitest-invocation-guard.test.ts` 为准。

⭐ It points at the **instrument** instead of restating what the instrument answers — `AGENTS.md` #9's own direction, applied to `AGENTS.md`. Turning it into an enumerated list of refused spellings would create a second copy that rots the moment the guard changes, in the one file four release notes cite as authority. ⛔ Keep the pointer.

## Why the text is worth landing at all, once the guard exists

The guard refuses the bad invocation; the prose explains **why the exit code cannot be read**. Those are different jobs. ⭐ The failure shape is a **FALSE GREEN**: `Tests 22 skipped (22)` with **exit 0**, no `0 tests matched` printed anywhere, and the previous bullet's `passWithNoTests` protection silent because the *file* filter did match. A reader who only learns 「the guard will stop you」 still does not know that **exit 0 is not a reading** on a named-test run — which is the sentence this whole board's measurement discipline turns on.
